# Superintendent toolkit — agent index

This folder holds the material written FOR agents (LLMs) working
on or through this toolkit. Everything else an agent needs is
indexed here, never duplicated: dual-facing sources stay in docs/
and are linked.

## Read in this order

1. [BEHAVIOURS.md](BEHAVIOURS.md) — how an agent should behave when
   operating this toolkit on a player's behalf: the observe → plan
   → act → verify loop, the §12 prepare → confirm → audit rule for
   anything that mutates the game, and the standing policies
   (priority groups, mod behaviour extraction).
2. [SANDBOX-PROTOCOLS.md](SANDBOX-PROTOCOLS.md) — the protocols
   for testing anything unproven (new command channels, risky
   flows) on throwaway sandbox saves only, with the game-id abort
   guards. Read before attempting any capability the website does
   not already expose.
3. [canon-for-agents.md](canon-for-agents.md) — GENERATED rendering
   of the canon (every threshold and reasoning rule, with status
   and provenance). Cite canon ids; the source is
   [docs/canon/](../docs/canon/README.md).

## By task

- **Playing a run** — BEHAVIOURS.md first, then the canon rendering
  for the thresholds behind any suggestion you surface, then the
  plan format (below) for the run's active plan.
- **Auditing guidance** — the canon source in
  [docs/canon/](../docs/canon/) is the truth; the drift check
  (`tools/check_canon.py`) proves the code still agrees with it.
  Player-facing guide sources: [docs/guides-research.md](../docs/guides-research.md),
  [docs/guides-earthworks.md](../docs/guides-earthworks.md).
- **Extending the canon** — edit the YAML families in
  [docs/canon/](../docs/canon/), regenerate with
  `tools/canon_to_json.py` (refreshes both `docs/canon/canon.json`
  and this folder's agent rendering), and keep
  `tools/check_canon.py` green.
- **Authoring or checking a plan** —
  [docs/GAME-PLAN-FORMAT.md](../docs/GAME-PLAN-FORMAT.md) is the
  format contract; plans live in [plans/](../plans/).

## The set

Agent-facing documents in this folder (the structure linter holds
this list to exactly these):

- [BEHAVIOURS.md](BEHAVIOURS.md)
- [SANDBOX-PROTOCOLS.md](SANDBOX-PROTOCOLS.md)
- [canon-for-agents.md](canon-for-agents.md) (generated)
